parent_objective: design a gate utility audit that classifies existing gates and historical repair logic before future training or paper claims
blocked_by: historical gates and row-specific repair logic may over-constrain the paper route without utility evidence
supersedes: using full historical gate stack as an unaudited permanent active blocker
invalidates: demoting or deleting gates without a candidate-based utility audit
continuing broad training before deciding which gates are core versus legacy

public_gates: M1184 may design the gate utility audit only
M1184 must not run candidate replay
M1184 must not demote or delete gates
M1184 must not train actor weights
M1184 must not use private holdout
M1184 must not change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not demote gates without evidence
do not claim paper evidence from design-only work

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_process: gate utility and engineering-logic cleanup design
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: defines the candidate sets, gate stacks, and keep/demote/deprecate rules needed before cleaning historical gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no gate demotion, replay result, controller performance, PPO, promotion, or paper result claim
stop_condition: stop if the design deletes or demotes gates without evidence
stop if the design omits known bad and known good candidate classes
stop if the design allows private holdout tuning
stop if the design changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: if candidate artifacts are missing, design an inventory milestone first
if gate commands are too expensive, split the audit into minimal/balanced/full stacks
if row-specific gates still catch unique failures, classify them as extended-regression rather than deprecated
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1182a paper route requires a gate utility audit before historical gates become permanent active blockers or are demoted

training_stage.stage_objective: design gate utility audit for engineering-logic cleanup
admission_evidence: M1182a paper-route plan requires gate utility audit
M1183 smoke confirms source-rich metadata infrastructure is available
historical rows and repair tools should not remain unaudited active blockers
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: follow-up utility matrix run is pre-registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1184 is process design only and does not test self-ID or current-frame substitution.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1184 only designs audit logic for future evidence governance.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If design finds candidate evidence insufficient, route to candidate inventory instead of weakening gate standards.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A pre-registered gate utility audit can determine which historical gates and repair tools are core, research-only, extended-regression, legacy, or deprecated before the paper route proceeds to broad training or gate cleanup.
success_criteria: candidate classes include good, known bad, near-miss, and no-op candidates
follow-up utility matrix run is pre-registered
no gate demotion, candidate replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: candidate replay, gate demotion, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts

commands.name: write_gate_utility_audit_design
commands.command: write docs/m1184-paper-route-gate-utility-audit-design.md and pre-register follow-up utility matrix run

decision_rule: M1184 passes if it designs a candidate-based gate utility audit with explicit classification rules and pre-registers the follow-up utility matrix run without running replay or changing gates.
